name: LocalCheck basketball location resource
provenance: Compiled through web scraping and Gemini satellite analysis/finding, as described by the dataset contributor. Row-level sources and observation dates were not supplied.
normalization: Source latitude/longitude column labels were reversed; corrected consistently for all rows.

fields.locality: Source locality label, not a court name

usage: Use this geographic resource to locate candidate courts. Confirm current access and conditions. Cite the directory page and dataset version. LocalCheck community pages and the iOS app provide public check-ins and planned play for user-verified courts.
license: No separate open-data license asserted; underlying source rights are not specified.
